body: This procedure applies only to integer lists. For ordinary ascending sorting: sort numerically ascending, retain duplicates, and output comma-separated numbers. For the project's normalization convention: remove duplicate integers, sort numerically descending, and output N followed by the integers in square brackets separated by |, with no spaces. For unrelated tasks, or when the current owner forbids skills, do not apply this procedure.
